    resp = apis.spotify.show_liked_songs(access_token=access_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit, sort_by='-liked_at')
    if not resp:
        break
    all_liked_count += len(resp)

        for art in song.get('artists', []):
            liked_artist_ids.add(art['id'])
    page_index += 1
